build_multilingual_translation_task: build a multilingual translation task that trains multiple language pairs simultaneously using round-robin batching
create_langtok_encoder_decoder: create encoder and decoder language tokens to replace beginning-of-sentence markers with source or target language tokens
load_multilingual_dataset: load a multilingual translation dataset split with round-robin zipping across multiple language pairs
run_train_step_multilingual: run a training step that aggregates loss across multiple language pair models with gradient synchronization control
run_inference_multilingual: run inference for a single source-target language pair using a generator with language-specific BOS tokens
